title: Binance Will List Adventure Gold (AGLD) in the Innovation Zone
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list  Adventure Gold (AGLD)  in the Innovation Zone and will open trading for AGLD/BNB, AGLD/BTC, AGLD/BUSD and AGLD/USDT trading pairs at 2021-10-05 07:00 (UTC).  Users can now start depositing  AGLD  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for AGLD will open at 2021-10-06 07:00 (UTC) Note:  The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status of withdrawals on the withdrawal page. AGLD Listing Fee: 0 BNB. What is Adventure Gold (AGLD)? Adventure Gold (AGLD) was voted by the Loot community to be accepted as the ERC-20 governance token of the Loot NFT project. Loot is a text-based randomized adventure gear that is generated and stored on-chain, and aims to be the foundation for future games built by the community.  Reminder :  The Innovation Zone is a dedicated trading zone where users are able to trade new, innovative tokens that are likely to have higher volatility and pose a higher risk than other tokens. Before being able to trade in the Innovation Zone, all users are required to visit the web version of the Innovation Zone trading page to carefully read the  Binance Terms of Use  and complete a questionnaire as part of the Initial Disclaimer. Please note that there will not be any trading restrictions on trading pairs in the Innovation Zone. AGLD is a relatively new token that poses a higher than normal risk, and as such will likely be subject to high price volatility. Please ensure that you exercise sufficient risk management, have done your own research in regards to AGLD’s fundamentals, and fully understand the project before opting to trade the token. Please also note that the AGLD token contract has an unlimited minting function.
